title: Give me a screenshot of the index page.

messages.content: Give me a screenshot of the index page.

Here's the index page (anonymous view) at **3840×2160** (1920×1080 @2x retina), full-page.

![CRS index — sign-in page, dark theme](crs-brain/data/screenshots/adhoc/index-dark-desktop.png)

## What it shows
- **Sign-in gate** — the index route for a logged-out visitor is the login screen: **CRS logo** + "Casino Reporting Suite" wordmark, then a centered **Sign in** card with Email and Password fields, a "Forgot password?" link, and a **Sign in** button.
- **Dark theme**, single centered card on a near-black (`#181818`) background; footer legal line ("Terms & Privacy Policy") and a green **"All systems operational"** status pill at the bottom (wired to the crs.statuspage.io embed).
- Layout is clean and correctly centered at desktop width — no overflow or broken elements.

## Notes
- This is the **anonymous** view. To see the actual authenticated dashboard/home, I'd capture it as a logged-in test user (`buildprint screenshot <testuser-email> "/"`). Say the word and I'll grab that, plus a light-theme and/or mobile version.
- Saved to `crs-brain/data/screenshots/adhoc/index-dark-desktop.png`.

steps.label: I'll capture the index page at our desktop standard (1920×1080 @2x retina). First I'll set the viewport and locate the app's run-mode URL.
steps.body: I'll capture the index page at our desktop standard (1920×1080 @2x retina). First I'll set the viewport and locate the app's run-mode URL.

steps.label: Set browser viewport to desktop retina
steps.body:
description: Set browser viewport to desktop retina
command: agent-browser set viewport 1920 1080 2

steps.label: Viewport set. Found custom domain `crsapp.live`. Let me confirm the full URL structure.
steps.body: Viewport set. Found custom domain `crsapp.live`. Let me confirm the full URL structure.

steps.label: Custom domain is `crsapp.live` with redirect-to-domain enabled, so the test run-mode index is `https://crsapp.live/version-test/`. Opening it now.
steps.body: Custom domain is `crsapp.live` with redirect-to-domain enabled, so the test run-mode index is `https://crsapp.live/version-test/`. Opening it now.

steps.label: Open the index page in run mode
steps.body:
description: Open the index page in run mode
command: agent-browser open "https://crsapp.live/version-test/"

steps.label: Page loaded. Reloading to ensure the retina viewport is fully applied before capture.
steps.body: Page loaded. Reloading to ensure the retina viewport is fully applied before capture.

steps.label: Reload page to apply viewport
steps.body:
description: Reload page to apply viewport
command: agent-browser reload

steps.label: Capturing the full page at the desktop retina standard.
Capture full-page screenshot of index
steps.body:
description: Capture full-page screenshot of index
command: agent-browser screenshot --full "C:/Users/CCTV Mgr/Projects/crs-progress/crs-brain/data/screenshots/adhoc/index-dark-desktop.png"

steps.label: The `adhoc` directory doesn't exist yet. Creating it, then re-capturing.
Create adhoc screenshots directory
steps.body:
description: Create adhoc screenshots directory
command: mkdir -p "C:/Users/CCTV Mgr/Projects/crs-progress/crs-brain/data/screenshots/adhoc"

steps.label: Capture full-page screenshot of index
steps.body:
description: Capture full-page screenshot of index
command: agent-browser screenshot --full "C:/Users/CCTV Mgr/Projects/crs-progress/crs-brain/data/screenshots/adhoc/index-dark-desktop.png"

steps.label: Screenshot saved. Now reading it to verify and report what it shows.
